rules: Reuse frozen H5 selector threshold/radius, unchanged across all three methods.
scope: Same 2D polynomial subspace size and 72-candidate budget at each block. Only frequency of action-Jacobian recomputation changes. Every arm observes its own actual history; finite verifier is refreshed every block in all arms. Expert nominal actions remain fixed.
local_diagnostics: After selection, execute nominal and chosen H5 action plus nominal suffix from identical current corrected-prefix root. These outcomes are evaluation-only and are never used by the next selector or Jacobian. Next history follows chosen actions only.
